title: Two Best Non-Overlapping Events
summary: Given a list of events with start times, end times, and values, select at most two non-overlapping events to maximize the total value.
statement: Given a list of events with start times, end times, and values, select at most two non-overlapping events to maximize the total value. Ensure no two events overlap, meaning the next event must start after the previous one ends.
constraints: Each event is [start,end,value] with inclusive endpoints and positive value.
Choose at most two events; two chosen events require the later start to be strictly greater than the earlier end.
hints: Sort by start and maintain completed earlier events ordered by end.
Before each start, move all events ending strictly earlier into a best-prior value, then combine it with the current value.
Pop heap while end<start, update best_previous, and maximize best_previous+value.
The heap exposes exactly compatible prior events; the stored maximum is their best value, so each possible later event forms its optimal pair when processed.
editorial: The heap exposes exactly compatible prior events; the stored maximum is their best value, so each possible later event forms its optimal pair when processed.

tests.explanation: The first two events do not overlap and total four.
Taking the single value-five event is better than the compatible pair worth four.
